mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag_info (tag_id, tag_name, tag_code, category_id, parent_id, tag_level, status, sort_order, pk_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{tagId}, #{tagName}, #{tagCode}, #{categoryId}, #{parentId}, #{tagLevel}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{pkId}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.update: UPDATE tag_info SET tag_name = #{tagName}, tag_code = #{tagCode}, category_id = #{categoryId}, parent_id = #{parentId}, tag_level = #{tagLevel}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tag_info ORDER BY sort_order ASC, gmt_create DESC
SELECT * FROM tag_info WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT * FROM tag_info WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag_info WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
